author: S.G.Gmelin, 1771
status: 나그네새 수백 마리 · 겨울철새 수십 마리
summary: 보기 드문 겨울철새이다. 유럽 동부와 동아시아의 북위 50~67° 지역에서 번식하고, 몽골, 중국 북부, 우수리 남부, 중앙아시아, 인도 북부, 이라크 등지에서 겨울을 난다. 수컷은 겨울이 되면 이마와 머리꼭대기가 흰 줄무늬가 있는 갈색으로 바뀌고 밤색이 거의 사라진다.

points.en: white crown and cheek stripe (breeding male)

points.ko: 흰 줄무늬가 있는 갈색 머리(수컷 겨울)
points.en: brown crown with white streaks (winter male)

sexes.male: 여름에는 머리꼭대기와 뺨선이 희고 눈썹선과 멱은 밤색이며, 가슴을 가로지르는 밤색 띠가 있다.
sexes.female: 머리가 회갈색에 검은 줄무늬가 있고, 연한 갈색 가슴에 거무스름한 줄무늬가 있다.

art.subject: Pine Bunting (Emberiza leucocephalos), adult male in early spring (March–April passage): white crown centre bordered by black at the sides of the crown and forehead; chestnut lores and supercilium around the eye; a white cheek patch outlined in black; chestnut chin and throat, cut off below by a white crescent across the upper breast; a chestnut band and chestnut streaks across the breast and on the flanks; belly white; mantle rufous-brown streaked black; rump chestnut; wings brown with buff edges; tail dark brown with white outer feathers; bill grey above, paler below; dark eye; pinkish legs.
art.scene: Korean dry farmland in early spring (March) with stubble fields, weedy field edges and scattered trees, cool clear light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male spring, side view perched: white crown edged black, chestnut supercilium and lores, white cheek patch edged black, chestnut throat, white crescent below it, chestnut band and streaks across the breast, white belly

adult male winter, side view perched: brown crown streaked white with the white centre partly showing, chestnut supercilium and throat partly veiled by pale fringes, white cheek spot edged dark, whitish crescent below the throat, chestnut streaks on the breast and flanks, white belly
adult female, side view perched: grey-brown head with black streaks, pale cheek patch with a dark border, pale brown breast with blackish streaks, rufous rump, no yellow anywhere
art.build: Rather large, long-tailed bunting, about 17cm, larger than a sparrow, similar in shape to Meadow Bunting (Emberiza cioides). Rounded, flat-crowned head without a crest. Bill small, conical and pointed, shorter than the head. Legs pinkish. Tail long and slightly notched, with white outer feathers that flash in flight. Feeds on the ground in fields and flies up to bushes and tree tops.
avoid: Do not paint any yellow in the plumage — that is Yellowhammer (Emberiza citrinella).
Do not paint chestnut cheeks with a white throat — that is Meadow Bunting (Emberiza cioides); the Pine Bunting has white cheeks and a chestnut throat.
Do not paint a crest; the crown is flat with a white centre.
Do not paint a black throat or an all-black head.
